source_chain.statement: Data availability identifies Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15640502 for the quantum circuits and data generated and analysed in the study.
Concept DOI cited by the Nature paper.
Zenodo version v1, published 2025-06-11, resolved as the concrete dataset version observed on 2026-08-18.

local_sha256.reason: The current execution environment could resolve the primary Zenodo metadata but could not retrieve the 41.9 MB binary: the web fetch refused the payload as too large and the container runtime had no working external DNS/download path.
local_sha256.next_test: Download OTOC2_circuits.zip in a network-capable reproducible runtime, verify the published MD5 first, compute SHA-256, record exact byte length and append a new receipt; do not overwrite this receipt.

F_ok: Primary Nature Data availability statement names the dataset concept DOI.
Zenodo v1 exposes a concrete version DOI, file name, display size and publisher MD5.
The route now has a stable external artifact locator independent of the news headline.
F_gap: Exact local byte length and SHA-256 are not yet measured.
Published MD5 has not yet been independently recomputed.
No figure/subset reproduction has been executed from the archive.
F_next: Acquire the binary in a network-capable runtime.
Compute SHA-256 and exact byte count.
Inspect archive inventory/README without executing untrusted code.
Select the smallest classically tractable circuit/data subset tied to a paper figure and reproduce one observable with a frozen environment.
F_esquecido: 10.5281/zenodo.15640502 is the concept DOI cited by the paper; 10.5281/zenodo.15640503 is the concrete v1 record observed here.
A publisher-provided MD5 is provenance metadata, not an independently reproduced hash.
Successful download/hash verification would validate artifact identity, not the scientific claim itself.

anti_regression.rule: Future binary/hash/reproduction receipts append evidence and may close individual gaps; this receipt remains as the historical observation of what was and was not verified on 2026-08-18.
